name: Westfield

streams.label: Recycling
streams.comment: In a holiday week the holiday's zone and every later zone that week move one day later (the 2026 schedule's footnotes).

important_notes: Westfield does not pick up household trash. You need a private hauler for your trash, and your hauler sets your trash days. The town only picks up recycling.
notes: Recycling is picked up every other week by Interstate Waste Services: Zones 1-5 (north of the railroad) one week and Zones 6-10 (south of it) the next, each zone on its own weekday.
Put your recycling at the curb by 6 AM on your pickup day, and not before 6 PM the evening before. In an apartment or condo, ask your building superintendent or property manager where it goes.

Accepted, all mixed in one reusable container: aluminum and tin cans, glass bottles and jars, plastic containers #1 and #2 only, newspapers, magazines, catalogs, junk mail, envelopes, computer and office paper, books (remove hardcover binders), telephone books, dry cardboard and chipboard, milk and juice cartons. Rinse bottles, jars, cans and cartons; paper must be dry and clean.

Not accepted: plastic bags of any kind, plastics #3-#7, Styrofoam, shredded paper, aerosol cans, batteries, light bulbs, ceramics, mirrors, window glass, Pyrex, plastic cups, plates and wrap, used paper towels.
When a holiday falls on a pickup day, that zone is picked up the next day and the zones after it that week each move one day later.
Report a missed pickup to Interstate Waste Services: westfieldrecycles@interstatewaste.com or 908-222-1566, option 8.

Leaves are collected by the same ten zones, in two passes. Rake them into narrow rows along the curb with a gap at the gutter, at least 10 feet from storm drains, with no other debris. In 2026 the last day to put leaves at the curb is Friday, December 4; collection is expected to end December 12. Up to 10 free biodegradable leaf bags per household at the Conservation Center (bring proof of residency).

Conservation Center, 1300 Lamberts Mill Rd: recycling drop-off is free for residents (also #5 plastics, electronics, scrap metal, Styrofoam, plastic film, food waste, clothing). Grass and brush need a yearly permit ($60, sold online only); bulk items need a one-time permit ($40-$80 by vehicle, $35 per mattress or box spring). Christmas trees are taken January through March. Fall hours (to December 20): Mon-Fri 9 AM-2:30 PM, Sat-Sun 9 AM-3 PM; closed December 21 to January 1.
sources: 2026 Curbside Recycling Schedule and Information (mailer, 12-11-2025), checked 2026-11-21: https://www.westfieldnj.gov/DocumentCenter/View/9697/Recycling-Schedule-2026 and https://www.westfieldnj.gov/189/Recycling-Schedule (its footnote numbers are one off; the mailer's are right)
No town trash pickup: Westfield's code requires every generator to contract a private collector (https://ecode360.com/33920815); the town's recycling pages cover recycling only
